source: https://rubygems.org/gems/<name> HTML, 1.2 s spacing, unauthenticated GET
method: status 'removed_recent' = page text 'removed by its owner ... reserved this gem name for N more days'; removal date estimated as capture date minus (100 - N) days, +/-1 day, using the 100-day yank reservation (cross-checked: Wayback 2026-09-12T01:35Z capture of mapanchorcf202704 reads 100 days). 'not_hosted' = 'This gem is not currently hosted on RubyGems.org' (older removal; no date on page). The page label says 'by its owner' for any yank, so it does not distinguish owner cleanup from registry action. handle = first 'Owners' handle, or 'Pushed by' on removed pages; multi-owner gems record only the first.
